event: BEI data showed the IHSG fell 3.71% in the week of 16-20 November to 5,146.33 and market capitalisation dropped to Rp8,725 trillion, while foreign investors' cumulative 2026 net sell passed Rp100 trillion. (update of E1004)
key_numbers: IHSG 5,344.41 to 5,146.33 (-3.71% w/w) · market cap Rp9,047T to Rp8,725T (-3.56%, about Rp322T lost) · foreign net sell Fri 20 Nov Rp947.41B · foreign net sell YTD Rp100.235T · avg daily value Rp12.35T (-47.9%) · Bloomberg IDX Foreign Flow Index -US$5.68B · IHSG about -40% YTD

event: OJK board chair Friderica Widyasari Dewi said the IHSG's fall from about 9,134 in January 2026 to around 5,000 is a logical consequence of capital market reforms such as removing high-concentration stocks and aligning the index with MSCI, and urged investors not to panic.
key_numbers: IHSG peak about 9,134 (Jan 2026) · now about 5,100-5,200 · eight reform steps cited · HSC stocks removed from IHSG calculation

event: Bank Indonesia Governor Destry Damayanti said BI is giving up to 45% discount on hedging costs (DNDF/swap) to pull foreign capital back into Indonesian assets, with US$14.1 billion of hedging transactions so far. (update of E0917)
key_numbers: discount up to 45% on DNDF · hedging transactions US$14.1B (June to 17 Nov 2026) · stock outflow YTD Rp81.6T · SBN+SRBI inflow YTD Rp143T

event: The rupiah moved close to Rp18,300 per US dollar on 20-21 November and analysts expect continued pressure next week despite BI's rate hike. (update of E1005)
key_numbers: USD/IDR about Rp18,270-18,297 (20 Nov) · BI Rate 6.00% · detik headline 'Makin Dekat ke Rp18.300'

event: Anthropic priced its Nasdaq IPO (ticker ANT) at US$83 per share, above the US$70-78 range, raising about US$81.3 billion and valuing the company around US$1.1 trillion, equal to about 84% of Indonesia's GDP and 2.2 times the IDX market cap.
key_numbers: IPO price US$83 (range US$70-78) · 980M shares offered · raise about US$81.34B (about Rp1,484.6T) · market value about US$1.1T (about Rp20,000T) · 2.2x BEI market cap (Rp9,047T) · first-day close reportedly US$97.17 (+17.1%) · public float about 7% · Indonesian retail cannot buy at IPO price

event: Indonesia and the European Union signed the IEU-CEPA trade deal and an Investment Protection Agreement in Brussels after about 10 years of talks, targeting entry into force on 1 January 2027.
key_numbers: 90.4% of Indonesian tariff lines at 0% on entry into force · 8.37% phased over 3-15 years · duty-free CPO quota 1.9M tonnes (+140,000 t palm oil) · trade about US$30B/year · EU investment about US$25B in 5 years · 72 GI products protected · EU Parliament debate begins 23 Nov

event: Nasdaq plans to station a team at the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) from December to help strengthen trading surveillance, as BEI tightens oversight and reports 34.3 million capital market investors.
key_numbers: Nasdaq team at BEI from December 2026 · investors 34.3 million · six companies reported queuing for IPO (detik 21 Nov)

event: Brent crude closed at US$92.57 per barrel on 20 November, down 3.41% on the week and a third straight weekly decline, as Hormuz shipments recovered; OPEC+ meets 29 November on 2027 quotas.
key_numbers: Brent Jan US$92.57 (-3.41% w/w; US$95.84 on 13 Nov) · WTI about US$83.41 (-5% w/w) · Goldman sees 2027 surplus about 2M bpd, Brent avg about US$88 · OPEC+ meeting 29 Nov

event: The Ministry of Forestry revoked the forest utilisation permit (PBPH) of PT RAPP (Group APRIL) over 338,536 hectares via decree 971/2026, announced by Satgas PKH; the government says operations will move to a BUMN/BUMD arrangement with no mass layoffs.
key_numbers: 338,536 ha PBPH revoked · SK Menhut 971/2026 dated 19 Nov · company says 41,000+ workers · about 18,363 ha oil palm in concession · 541 ha unpermitted mining · 212 ha protected area damage

event: Labour group KSPI estimates layoff (PHK) victims could exceed 90,000 people by end-2026, with textiles hardest hit, while a Liputan6 tally cites about 72,000 in 2026 so far.
key_numbers: KSPI estimate 90,000+ by end-2026 · Liputan6 count about 72,000 (2026 YTD) · textile industry most affected

event: Golkar chair Bahlil Lahadalia said DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad is among the preferences to replace Gibran as vice president, and that Prabowo will meet coalition party chairs (Gerindra, Golkar, PAN, Demokrat) at Hambalang before 25 November to prepare two names for the MPR. (update of E0898)
key_numbers: 2 names to MPR · meeting before 25 Nov 2026 · 4 coalition parties · MPR plenary 9 Dec 2026 (per storyline)

event: PAN, Sandiaga Uno, Wali Nanggroe Aceh, 98 activists and Sulsel academics publicly backed Gerindra figure Dasco as vice president, while Gerindra-aligned figure Bawono called allegations against Dasco baseless. (update of E0942)
key_numbers: 5+ backers named in Antara headlines 22 Nov

event: DPD chair Sultan Bachtiar Najamudin proposed that Indonesia have more than one vice president (Kompas headline says three), saying the idea dates from 2019, is not for now and needs a constitutional process.
key_numbers: 3 VPs (per Kompas headline) · idea first voiced 2019 · not for current vacancy

event: Polri announced Kapolri Telegram ST/2598/XI/KEP/2026 (dated 20 Nov) moving three senior officers who are suspects in the alleged wiretapping of the President (initials AS, EHS, SU) to Yanma Polri, as part of a rotation of 107 officers; Polri called it routine organisational dynamics. (update of E0562)
key_numbers: 3 suspects moved to Yanma · 107 officers in telegram (Suara Surabaya; other outlets report different totals) · telegram dated 20 Nov

event: Kapolda Bengkulu Irjen Yudhi Sulistianto Wahid, who knelt and apologised to Cipayung Plus students on 19 Nov, was replaced by Brigjen Augustinus Berlianto Pangaribuan in the same 20 Nov telegram; no official statement linked the move to the kneeling.
key_numbers: Kneeling 19 Nov · telegram 20 Nov · announced 22 Nov · deputy and 6 Kapolres also moved (headline)

event: Kejagung said it will continue legal proceedings against Pertamina crude-oil governance suspect Riza Chalid, a fugitive abroad, including a trial in absentia once he is listed DPO and a red notice is filed; the death penalty option is being studied but depends on legal parameters.
key_numbers: 2 steps for in-absentia trial: DPO listing + Interpol red notice · death penalty option under study · no loss figure in the report

event: Immigration Director General Hendarsam Marantoko said two WNI suspected of being recruited as Russian mercenaries were stopped at Juanda Airport around 19-20 Nov, and immigration will screen passport applicants and step up cyber patrols.
key_numbers: 2 WNI stopped at Juanda · stopped ~2 days before 22 Nov statement

event: Ma'ruf Amin, the former vice president, stood by his resignation as Ketua Dewan Pertimbangan MUI despite MUI's request that he stay; Jimly Asshiddiqie, Afifuddin Muhajir and Zainut Tauhid are named as possible successors with a new chair expected around December 2026.
key_numbers: Term 2025-2030 · successor expected ~Dec 2026 · 3 candidate names

event: DPR Deputy Speaker Dasco said he will consider legal action after his 17-year-old daughter was bullied on social media and pledged to speed up revision of the Child Protection Law; KPAI said parents' political differences must not make children targets.
key_numbers: Daughter aged 17 · statement 20 Nov · KPAI response 22 Nov

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that WhatsApp will stop working on certain older iPhone models at the end of November 2026. (update of E0991)
key_numbers: cutoff: end of November 2026 (model list and OS version not read, article blocked)

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that YouTube changed how it counts views and examined the effect on Indonesian influencers.
key_numbers: details of new counting rule not read (article blocked)

key_numbers: 8 ojol services stopped (per CNBC headline) · Gojek 8% commission since Jul 2026 (Bisnis, 8 Oct)

key_numbers: none verified

event: Megawati Soekarnoputri said at a STIPAN graduation oration that she will not join the Prabowo government ('Terima kasih, saya di luar saja'), also criticising wiretapping, the police and KPK; PDIP says it was not about the offer being too small. (update of E0678)
key_numbers: Said 19 Nov, 21:26 WIB · PDIP summoned by police 3 times, by prosecutors once (her account) · reactions from Gerindra and PKB on 22 Nov

key_numbers: Resignation letter dated 23 Dec 2025, processed only the week of 20 Nov 2026 · 2025-2030 term · no successor named yet
